validation.package_versions: Five application package/lock roots and Browser renderer at 5.1.44

assertions: Tenant-configured HTTPS CRM resources are allowed.
Tenant-configured private HTTP CRM resources are allowed.
Unlisted resource origins and unlisted ports are denied.
Credential-bearing URLs and non-HTTP(S)/WebSocket schemes are denied.
Tenant-configured WSS origins are allowed and unlisted WSS origins are denied.
Service-worker requests use active-session scopes; overlapping tenant scopes intersect and unattributed requests deny.
Electron onBeforeRequest source wiring uses WebContents/request initiator scope before allowing a request.
limitations: Offline policy and source-wiring tests only; no packaged Electron or real service-worker runtime was exercised.
No private CRM endpoint, customer data, database, device or deployment was used.
Customer deployments must configure every required CDN/API/WebSocket origin in the tenant allowlist.
